metadata.description: Marketplace for the dev-agents autonomous-coding agent harness.

plugins.name: dev-agents
plugins.description: Agent harness for autonomous coding on GitHub Copilot CLI — an RPI (Research, Plan, Implement, Review) pipeline of 11 specialist agents and 38 skills. Language, IaC, and tracker specifics ship as companion plugins.

plugins.name: dev-agents-dotnet
plugins.description: .NET / C# implementation and testing skills for the dev-agents harness — modern C#, xUnit/NUnit/MSTest/TUnit, EF Core, Aspire, and design-pattern review.

plugins.name: dev-agents-python
plugins.description: Python implementation and testing skills for the dev-agents harness — type-hinted src layout, pytest, coverage, and Ruff.

plugins.name: dev-agents-bicep
plugins.description: Bicep Infrastructure-as-Code skills for the dev-agents harness — Azure Verified Modules, AVM version updates, and Well-Architected alignment.

plugins.name: dev-agents-terraform
plugins.description: Terraform Infrastructure-as-Code skills for the dev-agents harness — azurerm/AzAPI providers, Azure Verified Modules, plan-diff analysis, and resource import.

plugins.name: dev-agents-ado
plugins.description: Azure DevOps Boards tracker mechanics for the dev-agents harness — work-item CRUD, WIQL queries, field and state conventions, and parent/child linking used by the backlog-manager agent.

plugins.name: dev-agents-github
plugins.description: GitHub Issues tracker mechanics for the dev-agents harness — issue CRUD, sub-issue hierarchy, labels, and project fields used by the backlog-manager agent.
